raw_answer_text:
Looking at the error message, the issue is clear: the `topology` genre does not support string labels as a positional argument on edge definitions. Lines 13-14 have unexpected arguments (`"Primary WAN"` and `"Backup WAN"`).

The edge labels need to be removed. In a topology figure, the node labels and the edge structure itself carry the meaning — the hub nodes are already labeled "Primary Hub" and "Backup Hub", making the distinction clear without edge labels.

Here's the corrected document:

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 topology
title "Branch office WAN uplinks"

node access1 "Access Switch 1"
node access2 "Access Switch 2"
node branch "Branch Router"
node hubprimary "Primary Hub"
node hubbackup "Backup Hub"

edge access1 -- branch
edge access2 -- branch
edge branch -- hubprimary
edge branch -- hubbackup
```

The topology genre interprets the four edges and five nodes as you described: two access switches connected to the branch router, which in turn connects to two separate hub routers. The node labels convey which hub is primary and which is backup.
